blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The delegates of this year’s Miss Asia Pacific International pageant visited so many towns and cities in the country, but they spent more time basking under the Cebu sun, hopping on and off buses and taking boat rides to get to their destinations across the province. For Cebu’s second consecutive year of hosting the Miss Asia Pacific International pageant, the ladies arrived in Mactan on the first official day of the 2026 edition on Sept. 21.
